# GeneralUser GS attribution

GeneralUser GS is created by **S. Christian Collins**:
https://schristiancollins.com/generaluser.php

Official packaging source: https://github.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS

The demo lazily obtains `GeneralUser-GS.sf2` from upstream commit
`684543d5e5efaef08d02be50dcda8d552478fa60`. The 32,319,396-byte asset must match
SHA-256 `9575028c7a1f589f5770fccc8cff2734566af40cd26ed836944e9a5152688cfe`.
It is cached outside the repository; no SoundFont binary is committed.

The original license is included verbatim in `GeneralUser-GS-LICENSE.txt`.
See that license for the author’s terms and sample-source notes. Synthesis output
uses the existing offline FluidSynth renderer; it does not require a live audio
device or an external MIDI rendering process.
